name: Zolpidem
class: Non-benzodiazepine GABA-A positive allosteric modulator (Schedule IV)
description: A non-benzodiazepine hypnotic selective for the alpha-1 subunit of the GABA-A receptor, approved for short-term treatment of insomnia. Carries a boxed warning for complex sleep behaviours.

systems.note: GABA-A positive allosteric modulation producing sedation; the labelled indication.
Hepatically metabolised; dose reduction is labelled in hepatic impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled dose reduction in hepatic impairment.
Boxed complex sleep behaviours and labelled next-day impairment.
